description.zh: 待删除实体ID列表，最多10个；同一批次必须为同一种entityType
description.en: An array of IDs for the meta entities to delete. You can specify up to 10 IDs in a single request. All entities in the batch must have the same EntityType.

descriptions.zh: 需要购买 DataWorks 专业版及以上版本才能使用。
descriptions.en: This operation requires DataWorks Professional Edition or higher.
